title: Fintech Banking App
description: A personal-banking app built around accounts, transfers, and spending insight—presenting balances and transaction history, supporting money movement, and visualizing spending through interactive charts backed by a mock REST API.
impact: Cross-platform fintech experience covering account overview, transfers, transaction history, spending insights, card management, and budgets across six platforms.
responsibilities: Built accounts overview with balances, quick actions, and card management including freeze and detail views.
Implemented peer-to-peer and internal money transfers with searchable, categorized transaction history.
Developed spending insights and breakdowns with interactive charts, budgets, and category-level summaries.
Delivered adaptive Material 3 layouts from phone to desktop with Riverpod, go_router, and Dio-backed repositories.
Backed the UI with a mock REST API and repository layer with loading, empty, and error states throughout.
achievements: Shipped a production-quality fintech app for iOS, Android, web, macOS, Windows, and Linux from a single codebase.
Turned balances and transactions into actionable spending insight with charts and category breakdowns.
Covered the core personal-banking loop from account overview through transfers and financial visibility.
